Assistant ProfessorB.A. (Mangalore University), MBA (Pondicherry University), Ph.D (Jain University) Linkedin Dr. Rajini K.S. is an Assistant Professor in the B.Com department with 12 years of teaching experience. With a deep-rooted interest in Human Resource Management, she is committed to student development and academic excellence. Passionate about education from a young age, she brings enthusiasm and dedication into the classroom. Outside academia, she enjoys cooking and actively engages in community service, finding great joy in helping those in need.
